note: Calibrated from a real Vital standalone GUI capture (Init Preset). Coords are in the reference_size pixel space; load_profile() scales them to the actual frame. Vital draws a WHITE pointer line over a teal fill-arc; pointer="white" reads the colourless pointer (bright + low-saturation) and ignores the arc, so absolute values are accurate (full SUSTAIN reads ~1.0). Extend by adding controls.

landmark.note: Vital V emblem (top-left, on dark skin, below the host title bar). Host-invariant calibration template-matches this to correct title-bar height differences between hosts. template/bbox in the png's px (cut from vital_init.png at 1.0x ref); ref_xy = bbox[:2]/template_scale.

matrix._note: Calibrated from vital_matrix.png (Init Preset, MATRIX tab). Columns: # | SOURCE | BIPOLAR | STEREO | MORPH | AMOUNT | DESTINATION. The AMOUNT control is a horizontal bipolar slider whose CENTERED handle (value 0.5) means NO modulation; an init patch's one blank row (source/dest show '-') must read inactive -> read_matrix returns []. Coords are in reference_size space (2x the 1171x718 fixture); _load_matrix scales to the frame. Only the first (blank) row is calibratable from the empty fixture, but Vital matrix rows are uniform -- raise `rows` once a populated capture exists.

fx_list._note: EFFECTS page only. The effects RACK is the FIXED vertical list (after MACRO 1-4); each row carries a power dot at its top-left — lit purple/pink (S~100-120, V~255) when on, grey (S~46) when off. ⚠️ x_dot MUST be the rack power-dot column (~160), NOT the effect icon (~430): the prior x_dot=430 read the effect's expanded PANEL content, which STACKS by enabled-order (a panel slides up into another effect's row slot when an earlier effect is off) → it misreported e.g. Delay-alone as Chorus. The power dot is FIXED per rack row and is the only reliable on/off signal. Calibrated LIVE across Chorus/Delay/both configs (computer-use): dot column x=160, Chorus row y=168, pitch 136 (reference space 2342x1436). Fixed top->bottom order is Vital's alphabetical rack.

fx_modules._note: Per-effect KNOB sub-profiles (rung 10), read by fx_params.read_fx_params. Vital's enabled effects show expanded panels that STACK by enabled-order, so a panel's y is dynamic: panel_top(E) = base_y + Σ height of enabled CALIBRATED effects before E in the fixed rack order. knob cx is absolute (panels share an x); knob dy is relative to that effect's panel_top. All white-pointer. Calibrated LIVE (computer-use) across Chorus-alone / Delay-alone / both — the both-config proved Delay's panel sits at base_y+235 (Chorus's height) and the delay-alone config proved it slides up to base_y. Only Chorus + Delay calibrated so far; an uncalibrated enabled effect before another blocks the latter's positioned read (reported position_unknown, never guessed).

_controls_note: OSC 1/2/3 LEVEL/PAN (+ OSC 1 unison/phase) calibrated from the Init Preset. OSC 2/3 are DIM (off on Init) but the white pointer is read skin-relative, so their LEVEL/PAN read correctly anyway (the coords are valid when a tutorial has them on). The reader records each knob's normalized POSITION [0,1] — the synth-specific position→display mapping (e.g. unison position 0.5 shows '20%') is non-linear, but recording position is reproduction-correct. Vital's filter CUTOFF/RESONANCE are GRAPH-DRAG controls (X/Y on the response graph), NOT knobs, so the white-pointer reader can't read them — those are graphic params for §8. FILTER 1's DRIVE/MIX/KEY-TRK ARE knobs (FILTER 1 = bottom-LEFT module; the FIL1/FIL2 labels there are serial-routing toggles, not the module identity); calibrated LIVE via computer-use (enabled FILTER 1, read defaults DRIVE 0 / MIX 1.0 / KEY-TRK 0.5, then a deliberate DRIVE drag → 0.81 to prove tracking) — they read ONLY when the filter is enabled (dim/off on Init reads unreliably). Fixture: vital_filter_on.png.
